data.name: Luna Drift
data.detailed_description:
Luna Drift

Feel the thrill of sideways driving and become a true drift legend in Luna Drift!

Step into a world built for drifting enthusiasts, where smoke-filled corners, high-horsepower machines, and endless roads are waiting for you. Choose from a wide collection of tuned drift cars, each offering unique handling characteristics and customization possibilities.

Master realistic drifting physics designed to provide the perfect balance between realism and fun. Whether you're a beginner learning your first slides or an experienced driver chasing perfect drift angles, Luna Drift delivers an exciting driving experience for every player.

Explore multiple detailed maps featuring city streets, mountain roads, industrial zones, highways, and dedicated drift areas. Every location offers new challenges and opportunities to improve your skills.

Enjoy a dynamic environment with different times of day, including beautiful daytime scenery and atmospheric night driving. Experience highly detailed vehicle interiors and switch to first-person view for maximum immersion behind the wheel.

Want to drift with friends? Luna Drift includes multiplayer support, allowing you to join online sessions, organize drift meets, compete for the best lines, and create unforgettable moments together.

The game also features realistic vehicle damage. Every collision leaves visible damage, making every drift run more intense and rewarding.

Features

  • Realistic drift physics and vehicle handling

  • Large collection of tuned drift cars

  • Multiplayer mode with friends

  • Multiple detailed maps and drift locations

  • Day and night environments

  • First-person driving experience

  • Highly detailed vehicle interiors

  • Realistic vehicle damage system

  • Stunning graphics and visual effects

  • Endless free-roam drifting opportunities

Burn rubber, create massive smoke clouds, perfect your technique, and become the ultimate drift master.

Start your engine and let the drift begin in Luna Drift.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel core i3
  • Memory: 5 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics card
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel core i5
  • Memory: 10 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 670
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
